title: Wayfair Is Selling a 'Beautiful' $350 3-Piece Dining Set for Just $120, and Shoppers Say It 'Looks So Sleek' - NewsBreak

If you buy something via one of our links, we may earn a commission. If your kitchen is tight on space, this is the kind of dining set that can make it feel instantly more functional. Wayfair is running a limited-time sale on the Ebern Designs Ezzah 3-Piece Dining Set . It’s currently marked down to $120 from $350, and for the price, it’s surprisingly well thought out. This dining set was created with smaller spaces in mind. It includes a slim rectangular table and two benches that slide right underneath when you’re not using them, which saves a ton of room. More than 1,000 shoppers have rated it 4.5 stars, with reviewers calling it everything from “sturdy and beautiful” to “perfect for my apartment.” The frame is made of powder-coated steel, and the wood-look tabletop gives it a clean, modern feel. Each bench can hold up to 550 pounds, and the table itself supports up to 330 pounds. You even get 12 silicone bumpers for the edges, which one reviewer pointed out is great if you’ve got little ones (or pets) who tend to zoom around the kitchen. Assembly is simple, even for beginners. Multiple reviewers noted they finished in 30 minutes or less. One said, “I absolutely love this set. I am disabled and was able to assemble this completely on my own from a seated position.” Another confirmed, “Very easy to put together, and perfect for a small space.” Related: Wayfair Is Selling a 'Quality' $250 Floral Area Rug for Just $84, and Shoppers Call It 'Absolutely Beautiful' From a style perspective, the clean lines and neutral finishes make it an easy fit with most decor. Options include all-black, gray and black, and a retro wood-tone finish that gives off a slightly more rustic feel. “Literally love this table, it’s perfect and looks so sleek,” one reviewer said. It’s available in four colors, with the solid black colorway boasting the biggest discount. If you’ve been searching for a space-saving solution that still feels stylish, this one’s a steal. Be sure to grab the Ebern Designs Ezzah 3-Piece Dining Set while it’s still marked down.
